run_repeat_lines: run repeat_lines.py to repeat each line of an input file N times to stdout or an output file
run_repeat_lines_to_file: run repeat_lines.py with an output file argument to write repeated lines to a specified file
run_repeat_lines_stdout: run repeat_lines.py without an output file to print repeated lines directly to stdout
review_normalize_spaces: review the _normalize_spaces function that collapses multiple whitespace into single spaces in a line
test_repeat_lines: test repeat_lines.py by providing an input file and repeat count to verify correct line duplication
